EXT.evidence: Talkative and assertive at the table, directs others (“hop back in”), makes jokes/pranks (“your fly’s still open”), and declares he couldn’t be more in—energetic and outgoing.

AGR.evidence: Gloats about winning, says the other will never see their money, mocks them, and tricks them into looking at their fly—boastful and unsympathetic.

CON.evidence: No clear behavior showing organization/efficiency or sloppiness/carelessness; remarks are mostly teasing and gloating.

NEU.evidence: Displays confidence and no anxiety—boasts about his hand, is fully in, and taunts others.

OPN.evidence: No concrete signs of curiosity or imaginative interests; a simple prank and risk-taking do not strongly indicate openness.
